svg.aria-label: Iterations are cheap: Edit, run, inspect trace, repeat. Ten documented tweaks (prompts, termination rule, max_rounds, MAX_TOOL_CALLS, search_depth="advanced", model per role, a new role, tools for the judge) are listed in docs/REFERENCE.md. Validation is mostly manual, via traces: tests/ holds offline regression tests for the forced-close and judge-cap edge paths and the rate-limit guardrail. Not in scope: No persistence, no UI, no API (CLI only), no streaming, no tool caching, no cross-turn source dedup, no multi-user sessions. Tools for proposer and critic only (Approach 1): Approach 2, the judge as fact-checker with receipts, is mapped in the Tavily design spec, not wired in. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-21-tavily-tool-use-design.md. Fork freely
